facts.fact: Adwave's self-serve TV campaign minimum budget is $50, according to the vendor.
Adwave says small businesses can access the TV trust advantage for under $100.
facts.quote: You can now access that trust advantage for under $100.

facts.fact: The vendor cites research from Marketing Week and Nielsen stating that TV scores 20-40% higher on trust metrics than digital alternatives.
facts.quote: The gap isn't small: TV consistently scores 20-40% higher on trust metrics than digital alternatives.

facts.fact: The vendor states that a basic TV commercial cost $50,000-$500,000 to produce in the past.
facts.quote: A basic TV commercial cost $50,000-$500,000 to produce

facts.fact: The vendor states that most traditional TV buys required minimum spends of $10,000 or more.
The vendor's suggested trust-building experiment uses a $50-100 TV campaign.
The vendor's suggested trust-building experiment runs the campaign for 2 weeks.
Adwave says its platform generates professional 30-second commercials from a business's website.
facts.quote: generate professional 30-second commercials from your website in minutes

facts.fact: According to AdWave, TV presence can be started for under $100 using streaming TV platforms.
facts.quote: You can start building TV presence for under $100 with streaming TV platforms.

facts.fact: According to AdWave, most advertisers see measurable awareness lift after 4-6 weeks of consistent TV advertising.
facts.quote: Most advertisers see measurable awareness lift after 4-6 weeks of consistent advertising.
